excerpts.text:
Research retains 840MiB admitted artifacts, 32MiB controlled explicit scratch,
1800s per child, one heavy headless lane, one-use/unreset accounting and actual
cancellation/reap/read settlement/quarantine. Compiler CPU/internal heap/RSS and
temporary peak disk remain unqualified. No renderer, Ready or activation credit.

The NEW limit is NOT SELECTED. First close the exact complete runner/producer/
verifier upper U and their payload/error lifetimes. Derive one finite checked
limit from that U, then obtain independent review before immutable data binding.
Choose no convenient power of two, padding, multiplier, split or budget reset.

- Count each reached scalar/literal read, destination initialization/write,
  arithmetic/bitwise/comparison/boolean/conversion, selected branch, call entry/
  dispatch/return and actual loop/control event once. This is not CPU cycles.
- Caller evaluation supplies the source read of a by-value copy. Callee parameter
  initialization supplies its destination write; do not invent a second source
  read for the same copy. Reference arguments do not copy their referents.
- Guaranteed direct prvalue construction initializes its destination once.
  Optional NRVO alternatives retain their real copy/move obligations.
- Uninitialized storage has no invented zero value or write. Explicit constructor
  entry/return and any independently defined lifetime event are separate facts.
- Expand selected C++ SDK/STL and our helper bodies under the pinned source and
  compiler profile. No optimizer or new opaque-category discount supplies fit.
- Existing OS/CRT/libm and CLR codec/JSON runtime internals remain the declared
  primitive CPU/general-heap boundary. Public source availability does not move
  that boundary. Audit behavior and every controlled payload/clone/temporary
  without claiming primitive CPU, general CLR heap, allocator overhead or RSS.
- Count all quotation, Catalogue, Meter/Spend, validation, default/aggregate,
  receipt, failure and retirement source in a finite nonrecursive schedule.
  Reservations/quoted upper work are distinct from measured actual visits.

encode. Include preprocessing clones, escape/output buffers, returned UTF16,
Replace/LF results if retained, UTF8 bytes, prior buffers, parsed results, source
containers and quarantine in simultaneous payload phases. No 32MiB fit is granted.

## Other mandatory source corrections

Admit Repo/NewRunRoot and derived suffix lengths before variable path copies/
scans. Bound C++ argv root/manifest/mode before std::string/strcmp traversal or
enforce an equally explicit exact launcher domain. Bound C++ exception diagnostic
output. Use bounded structured failure-inventory diagnostics, not full messages.

Preserve the primary error/raw child result separately from footer/fence/serializer
failures; a throwing finally fence must not replace the primary cause. Record both
outcomes and keep raw exits/logs. Footer failure always prevents certification.
Do not serialize opaque Exception/ErrorRecord graphs into the controlled schema or
claim their general CLR heap is bounded by the controlled scratch worksheet.

Include actual split/filter callback prefixes and join delimiters, or replace them
with genuine reviewed bounded source. Close all bootstrap/34 existing helpers/new
helpers/main/76 C++ families and their transitive source/error/instrumentation rows.
Recompute exact lineage/namespace/include/hash/byte/slot profiles, including every
new source, contract, census and eventual constant-data identity. Equal bytes do
not merge distinct paths or simultaneous owners.

New sources retain false guards and unbound private immutable Catalogue data.
Fresh whole functional review precedes complete independent census/lifetime review,
derived-limit review, binding-source review and separate root one-attempt GO.
No source maximum, partial floor or manual PASS supplies any missing proof.
